metrics.label: New KEV entries
metrics.rule: CVE entries whose CISA dateAdded falls in the month.

metrics.label: Distinct vendors
metrics.rule: Unique vendorProject values among the month’s KEV entries.

metrics.label: Known ransomware use
metrics.rule: Month’s KEV entries where CISA sets knownRansomwareCampaignUse = Known.

metrics.label: EPSS ≥ 90th percentile
metrics.rule: Month’s KEV entries with EPSS percentile ≥ 0.90 (scores as of 2026-11-22).
